summary: Google sign-in UI must be user-initiated with a persistent button (no automatic One Tap/FedCM prompt on service pages); after login the returned page visibly confirms the signed-in account and service gates never read as login failure.
approvalBasis: The platform owner reported on 2026-10-27 (KST) that on EKODI 동행 a Google notice at the top of the screen appeared and vanished so login seemed impossible, and instructed EKODI to run the full audit → constitution/enforced-rule amendment → before/after tests → production deploy and live verification cycle.
adds: automatic google.accounts.id.prompt forbidden outside registered auth surfaces (repository scan in validate:constitution)
prompt surfaces must render a persistent Google button
returned page shows signed-in account and sign-out
prelaunch/permission gates state that login succeeded
auth page names the reused account during central-session handoff
rollback: Revert only the v1.27.4 additions (constitution text, policy keys, prompt scan, Singles account card and auth-page account notice) while preserving v1.27.3.
